note: The medians are the median of the harness's 5 runs' p50 (D93), recorded from benchmarks/history/2026-11-08-201f701.json on ubuntu26 image 20261101.186.1 (AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, 4 cores) with Node v28.0.0-nightly20261107a43bfb5bb2. The compare warns above 5 % and fails above 15 % of regression, with a floor of 0.01 ms (a baseline median below it is reported, not compared); a median above target_ms fails. Runner noise (+/-20-40 %) makes the 5 %/15 % compare a coarse tripwire, not a verdict, until the 1.9 CodSpeed gate.
